question: Which polo team made history in 2025 by sweeping all major awards for the fourth consecutive year at the Indian Polo Awards held in Jaipur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Achievers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Achievers** polo team created history in **2025** by sweeping all major honors at the **Indian Polo Awards**.
 
• This remarkable achievement marked the **fourth consecutive year** that the team has dominated the awards ceremony, establishing a record for consistency in the sport.
 
• The ceremony was held in **Jaipur**, **Rajasthan**, which is widely considered the heart of polo in India.
 
• The awards recognized the team's exceptional performance across the national circuit, including their victories in several high-handicap tournaments during the season.
 
• By winning categories such as **Best Team** and producing the **Most Valuable Player**, the **Achievers** have solidified their status as the premier polo
